title: Tilda's Pebble Plan
markdown:
Tilda was a little rabbit who loved things neat and tidy! Her cozy home under the ground was perfect, with smooth grey pebbles lined up just so.

Tilda was getting ready for school, held under a friendly oak tree. Tilda had a little worry. Her friend Wes the duck loved to share his loud ideas, and Tilda couldn’t always share her own. It felt wobbly and messy.

One day, after Wes’s big talk about worms, Tilda’s nose twitched. Her fluffy ears drooped. Worry tickled her whiskers. "Oh dear," she sighed. "How can we share ideas kindly without such a fuss?" She wished her thoughts were as neat as her pebbles.

Because she worried, Tilda had a new idea! "I shall collect polite phrases!" she told her reflection. Her determined face smiled back. That’s the curious thing about thinking hard; a grand idea pops right out!

The very next day at school, Wes was shouting about his plan for a super-splishy-splashy puddle. "It will be the best puddle EVER!" he quacked. All the other creatures nodded, but Tilda’s ears twitched. She had an idea for a leaf slide, but Wes’s quacks were like a noisy waterfall.

"Excuse me, Wes?" Tilda said, her voice small but clear. Wes paused. "Yes, Tilda?" he asked, softer now. "I have an idea for a slide," Tilda whispered, feeling a wobble. She held up a smooth, grey pebble. "This pebble is for being quiet for a moment," she explained. Wes looked at the pebble, then at Tilda. "Oh," he said. "A slide? That sounds wonderful!"

Wes took a deep breath. Instead of quacking, he said, "Tilda, tell us about your slide idea!" Tilda beamed. She explained her leafy slide. Wes listened. "That’s a brilliant idea, Tilda!" he quacked, a happy, happy quack.

Tilda learned that sharing ideas is like a game of catch. You must listen, and sometimes, you need a gentle way for everyone to have a turn. With Tilda’s pebbles and Wes’s big heart, they made the best splishy-splashy puddle with a super-duper leafy slide. Everyone giggled with delight, and the meadow seemed even brighter with all their happy, shared ideas.
characters: Tilda the rabbit, Wes the duck, Mr. Pine
author: StoryGen Community
